title: WIP: update xrefs to use new IntersectionObserver terms
body:
See https://github.com/w3c/IntersectionObserver/issues/427

---

This is work-in-progress, and needs additional changes to IntersectionObserver spec for the remaining TODOs. I'll report a new issue about this.
